deploy-bot: [ROLLBACK INITIATED] env=prod-us-east-1 release=v1.12.4 -> revert to v1.12.3 commit=5f4e2b9 reason=canary-latency-spike run_id=rb-2024-06-12-09 https://deploy.redwood.ai/runs/rb-2024-06-12-09
jamie: Ack. Lina (oncall) — can you confirm whether the error spike is still visible? If not, we can proceed with the controlled rollback.
lina: @jamie checking traces now. Jaeger shows p95 spike on runtime-api from 09:02–09:04 that correlates with the canary. Starting smoke tests on v1.12.3 and watching logs.
priya: Running rollback playbook steps: 1) scale down canary pods 2) promote previous replicaset 3) verify health checks. Command I'll run: `kubectl -n runtime rollout undo deploy/runtime --to-revision=rev-2` and then `kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime=registry.redwood.ai/prod:v1.12.3` — logging in runbook.
deploy-bot: Rollback progress: draining canary nodes -> switching traffic 50% (09:05) -> verifying. Current status: 50% traffic on v1.12.3, 50% on v1.12.4.
albert: Please pin v1.12.3 in the deployment config until we have a hotfix. Also create a ticket for root cause and include perf traces.
jamie: Created INF-4012: "investigate v1.12.4 latency regression" https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4012 — linking logs and canary metrics.
deploy-bot: [ROLLBACK COMPLETE] env=prod-us-east-1 reverted_to=prod-v1.12.3 commit=2a9b7c4 completed_at=1746501440 run_id=rb-2024-06-12-09 details=https://deploy.redwood.ai/runs/rb-2024-06-12-09/logs
lina: :thumbsup: Smoke tests passed on v1.12.3, healthchecks OK, traces back to baseline. I'll add notes to the incident doc and keep monitoring for 30m.
priya: I'll pin tag `prod-lock/v1.12.3` in the k8s config and block auto-rollouts until INF-4012 is resolved. Also scheduling a short postmortem tomorrow.
albert: I'll draft the release-note blurb and an internal summary for sales/support. Thanks all — nice quick roll back.
